method_notes: Predictions favor teams with superior tournament goal differences and clean sheets, while factoring in fatigue for teams like Paraguay and Egypt who endured penalty shootouts in the Round of 32.

predictions.reasoning: France's lethal attack and dominant 3-0 form should comfortably bypass a fatigued Paraguay side coming off an intense penalty shootout.
Canada's strong defensive stability shown in their two consecutive clean sheets will narrowly stifle Morocco's attack.
Brazil's depth and elite squad quality will easily breach a leaky Norway defense that has leaked eight goals so far.
Mexico's home-continent crowd and unbreached defense will force extra time against England, where El Tri edges out a win.
Spain's immaculate defensive record gives them a slight tactical edge over Portugal in a highly competitive Iberian derby.
Home advantage and robust team defensive chemistry carry the United States past a talented but leaky Belgium side.
Argentina's lethal attacking unit will dominate an exhausted Egypt side coming off a grueling penalty shootout.
Colombia's rigid defensive structure drags Switzerland into extra time, where the South Americans prevail on stamina.
